d: Bibisi varld sarvis ki ek investigeshan men samne aaya hai ki jephri epastin aur modling ki duniya ke kuchh bare namon ke bich sanbandhon ke sabut hain. inmen se ek shakhs abhi bhi ek modling ejensi chala raha hai. bibisi aaee ne yues dipartament of jastis ki or se jari kie gae eemel, traival rikord aur viza dokyuments ko jancha parkha hai. isse pata chala hai ki doshi thahrae jane ke bad bhi epastin ne modling ejensiyon ke zarie mahilaon tak pahunch banaee. bibisi ne duniyabhar ki 100 se zyada modals se bat ki aur inmen se kuchh ne pahli bar apne sath hue yaun shoshan ke bare men bataya.…
